Research.007.value: Better pathways begin with better understanding.

Research.008.label: Text: Climate change and the energy demands of chemical manufacturing motiva
Research.008.value: Climate change and the energy demands of chemical manufacturing motivate new approaches to essential redox chemistry. Processes such as Haber–Bosch nitrogen fixation and conventional hydrogen production historically rely on high temperature or high pressure.

Research.009.label: Text: Team VW studies fundamental mechanisms of energy-conversion reactions
Research.009.value: Team VW studies fundamental mechanisms of energy-conversion reactions and explores how carefully designed catalysts can use light or electricity under milder conditions. The objective is not simply to make a catalyst work, but to understand the reaction network well enough to improve it rationally.

Research.017.value: Team VW’s research story spans homogeneous molecular catalysis, heterogeneous films, semiconductor interfaces and biological inspiration. That breadth is connected by a common question: what elementary processes control the observable catalytic response?
